question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Enrich
solution:
The correct answer is "**Deplete**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word.
 
 
• **Enrich**: improve or enhance the quality or value of.
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given options.​
 
 
• **​Deplete: **use up the supply or resources.
 
• **Grace: **smoothness and elegance of movement.
 
• **Displease: **make (someone) feel annoyed or dissatisfied.
 
• **Garnish: **decorate or embellish (something, especially food).
 
 
 
• ​As per the meaning of the given words, "**deplete**" is the antonym of the word "enrich".
 
 
• ​**Example**: *My savings are **depleted **__after setting up the new restaurant business*.
 
 

​Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**
